objective: Preallocate index-scan data keys from table and row-id lengths.

tasks.title: Preallocate index-scan data keys
tasks.result: Index scan data-key construction now uses explicit-capacity helpers instead of format! in primary-key lookup and range paths.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The data-key helpers reserve exactly enough capacity for data:<table>:<row_id> and the NUL-suffixed upper bound key.
The optimization replaces format! in index-scan primary-key lookup, primary LIKE prefix scan, and primary BETWEEN range construction.
Generated key bytes, row-cache keys, scan prefixes, scan range upper bounds, index exactness, row decoding, and SQL results are unchanged.
The full sql_dml regression emitted existing SSTable retry warnings after passing; the command exited successfully.
